title: FC A01: Certificates
officialText:
A01.1 Certificate fees.

Applicants for certificates required pursuant to the provisions of this code or the rules shall pay the fees specified in this section. Fees for certificates shall be per year, except as otherwise indicated. Fees for written and practical examinations shall be per examination.

Fee

1.Blasting contractor certificate

Original application

$105.00

Renewal application

$50.00

2.Certificate of approval (per application)

Original application

$305.00
